title: Nothing Goes to Waste - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Nothing Goes to Waste trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Nothing Goes to Waste phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sits in the same area as Acolyte Hansui, which is why guides usually cover the two together.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 12 of 36 on the list - before it Crossroads of Blood · after it All Return to Dust. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
